name: Hard Times
overview: Scripture teaches that during hard times, believers are not left to face challenges alone but are assured of God's presence, strength, and deliverance. God promises to go before His people, encouraging them to be courageous and unafraid because He will never forsake them. Trials and tribulations are not only inevitable but serve to develop patience and deepen reliance on God, who offers peace and victory through Christ's overcoming of the world.
